subject: website
name: UBNet Public Vote
summary: The public vote page of UBNet: a hand-written page with a readable script.js plus the vendored ethers and Spasm SDK (spasm-network/spasm.js, MIT) bundles, served as written (no licence file). It runs no third-party code. It relies on the UBNet server my.eth-ub.net for the vote feed and settings, so it is at most Level 3; it also loads Google Fonts and reads Ethereum from publicnode.

connections.name: my.eth-ub.net (UBNet node API)
connections.note: Health, settings and the vote feed are read from this server when the page opens; signed votes are submitted to it.

connections.name: ethereum-rpc.publicnode.com
connections.note: Ethereum RPC read without a light client, called when the page opens.

connections.name: Google Fonts
connections.note: Stylesheet and font files fetched when the page opens; tells Google the visit.
